examples.rationale: Market-wide long liquidation cascade on 2026-06-04. BTC fell to ~$61,300-61,384 (lowest since Feb 2026), with the most severe drop reported at 02:00 UTC. Approximately 85% of ~$1.7-1.73B in 24h liquidations were long positions; BTC specifically accounted for ~$750-777M of liquidations. Figures independently corroborated by two separate outlets with consistent numbers (within ~3%).
